name: io.github.wundervault/wundervault-mcp
description: AI agents use your API keys, SSH keys and wallets through a local broker, never holding them

environmentVariables.name: WUNDERVAULT_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: The agent's name, as added in your vault and enrolled on this computer with wundervault-agent --enrol.

environmentVariables.name: WUNDERVAULT_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the token that wundervault-agent --enrol saved for this agent.
